# All EDs statistics

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Every emergency department's open movements and how long each has been open.

## What is on the screen

1. Statistics views. Network, Compare, Services, Wards, EDs, Teams and Weekly.
2. Open movements by ED. One dot per person, by hours since the movement opened.
3. Every ED. Open ED movements, including transit. Sort by any column.
4. Time since opening. Open movements counted in bands by how long they have been open.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
